article_title: Abhijeet Dipke, CJP: The student behind 'cockroach' protests that forced an Indian minister to quit

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly examining?
options: The history of every Indian political party since independence
A court case about university admissions in Boston
How Abhijeet Dipke's spontaneous post grew into a youth protest movement and the challenges it now faces
A government plan to replace rural schools with online courses
tasks.correct_answer: How Abhijeet Dipke's spontaneous post grew into a youth protest movement and the challenges it now faces
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מתארת כיצד פוסט ספונטני של דיפקה הפך לתנועת מחאה ארצית, הביא להתפטרות שר, וכעת ניצב בפני מבחן ההמשכיות.

tasks.prompt: What immediate event inspired Dipke's “What if all cockroaches come together?” post?
options: A leaked medical exam paper
A police march towards parliament
The resignation of the education minister
The chief justice comparing some jobless youngsters to cockroaches
tasks.correct_answer: The chief justice comparing some jobless youngsters to cockroaches
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הפוסט היה תגובה לדבריו של נשיא בית המשפט העליון, שהשווה צעירים חסרי עבודה לג'וקים; הוא טען אחר כך שדבריו פורשו לא נכון.

tasks.prompt: What does “galvanising support” mean in the account of Sonam Wangchuk's hunger strike?
options: Forcing supporters to leave the protest
Creating legal protection for demonstrators
Energising and rallying more people behind the movement
Reducing the protest to an online discussion
tasks.correct_answer: Energising and rallying more people behind the movement
tasks.explanation_hebrew: galvanising support פירושו לעורר, ללכד ולהניע אנשים נוספים לתמוך בתנועה.

tasks.prompt: What happened after security forces used force on protesters on 20 July?
options: The CJP immediately dissolved
The government permanently blocked all social media
Dipke returned to Boston and ended the campaign
Images of the clashes triggered wider support and protests spread to other cities
tasks.correct_answer: Images of the clashes triggered wider support and protests spread to other cities
tasks.explanation_hebrew: התמונות של צעירים שנפגעו מכוח המשטרה גרמו לגל תמיכה; אלפים הגיעו והמחאות התרחבו לערים נוספות.

tasks.prompt: Why did attempts to portray the CJP as representing a narrow interest gain relatively little traction?
options: The movement focused on employment and an exam leak that affected students across caste and religious lines
The CJP was officially part of the governing BJP
Only government employees were allowed to join
The campaign avoided all discussion of education
tasks.correct_answer: The movement focused on employment and an exam leak that affected students across caste and religious lines
tasks.explanation_hebrew: האבטלה והדלפת בחינת הקבלה נגעו לקבוצות רחבות של צעירים ומשפחות, וחצו גבולות של דת וקאסטה, ולכן היה קשה לצמצם את המחאה לזהות אחת.

tasks.prompt: What does “climbdown” mean when describing the education minister's resignation?
options: A carefully planned election victory
A rise in the minister's public standing
A move from national to local office
A retreat or reversal under pressure
tasks.correct_answer: A retreat or reversal under pressure
tasks.explanation_hebrew: climbdown הוא נסיגה מעמדה בעקבות לחץ; כאן הממשלה נאלצה לוותר במהירות ולהסכים להתפטרות השר.

tasks.prompt: Trace the main events from Dipke's social-media post to the education minister's resignation.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להציג רצף כרונולוגי ברור של הקמת CJP, המחאה סביב הבחינה, ההפגנות, תגובת הכוחות וההתפטרות.
expected_points: Dipke posted the cockroach question on 16 May
The response led him and others to launch the satirical CJP
The campaign focused on anger over the leaked medical entrance exam
The first Jantar Mantar protest on 6 June drew hundreds
Support grew during Sonam Wangchuk's hunger strike
Security forces dispersed the 20 July march towards parliament
Images of force produced a surge of support and wider demonstrations
Protesters demanded Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan's resignation
Pradhan stepped down on 25 July

tasks.prompt: Analyse why Dipke's decision to return to India involved both political risk and a question of credibility.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את סיכוני המעצר או התגמול ואת החשש שאי־חזרה תיתפס כבגידה בתומכים.
expected_points: His account and website had been withheld under Section 69A
Officials reportedly cited national-security concerns
Critical activists and journalists have faced questioning, cases or jail
A lawyer warned he could be detained without formal charge or trial under the NSA
His family feared imprisonment or attack
Remaining in the US could make followers feel betrayed
Returning allowed him to challenge the claim that he was a national-security threat
His presence strengthened his credibility as a movement leader

tasks.prompt: Summarise the CJP's rise, its political achievement and the strategic questions it now confronts.

expected_points: The movement began with a spontaneous response to the chief justice's remark
It channelled youth anger over jobs and the leaked medical exam
Police force against protesters expanded public support
Opposition parties rallied behind it
The education minister resigned after sustained pressure
The CJP now describes itself as a pressure group beyond elections
Its new campaign concerns conditions in rural government schools
Its organisation remains loose and sometimes ad hoc
Critics question which caste and religious issues it chooses to address
Its long-term test is sustaining attention and public trust

tasks.prompt: Write a balanced analytical paragraph assessing whether the CJP can become a lasting accountability movement.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לטעון טענה מאוזנת באנגלית, להשתמש בראיות להצלחת התנועה ולציין לפחות שני אתגרים לעתידה.
expected_points: Refer to the rapid growth from an online post to mass demonstrations
Use the minister's resignation as evidence of political influence
Mention the broad appeal of education and employment concerns
Consider the new rural-school campaign
